title: Standards for Measures by Personal Information Controllers on Automated Decisions (PIPC Notice) and Guide on Data Subjects' Rights
title_original: 자동화된 결정에 대한 개인정보처리자의 조치 기준 (고시) / 자동화된 결정에 대한 정보주체의 권리 안내서
summary: Personal Information Protection Commission notice, pre-announced for comment in May 2024 and effective 26 September 2024, setting out what businesses and public bodies must do when they make fully automated decisions, including AI-based ones, under Article 37-2 of the Personal Information Protection Act. PIPC published a case-based guide with it explaining when a decision counts as automated, how to give meaningful explanations, how to handle refusals and reviews, and how to publish criteria in advance. The guide includes a self-assessment checklist and encourages explainable-AI techniques.
key_obligations: Publish automated-decision criteria and procedures on the website in advance
Give meaningful, simplified explanations on request, not complex mathematical detail
Suspend a refused decision and notify the data subject of the outcome
Review data subjects' submitted opinions and report the result
